title: Inheritance
explain: A subclass `extends` another class and inherits its fields and methods. It can replace a method with `@Override`, and `super` calls the parent's version. Prefer composition when the relationship is "has a" instead of "is a".
exercise: Add a `Cat` subclass and a loop that prints the sound of every `Animal` in a list.
tip: Always add `@Override`. If you misspell the method name, the compiler tells you instead of silently creating a new method.
